Saenz is assistant engineer on FACSAT-3, which is transitioning from nanosat (FACSAT-1 3U/2018, FACSAT-2 6U) to a microsat adding a NEW propulsion subsystem — they explicitly need training + thermal-vacuum/space qualification, which is exactly the NCE + suborbital flight-test value prop. FAC research lines: satellite platforms, spatial-data exploitation, mission-control SW, space domain awareness, satcom, and AIV (assembly-integration-verification). State Dept approval for the transfer estimated ~2 months (same as the Italy/Sardinia precedent). ⚠ ITAR/EAR/TAA/MLA + securities-adjacent framing — gov/foreign-national channel, route through Jon; nothing auto-sent.
